_comment: Tune per project. This file may set 'severity' and 'ignore' ONLY: a 'patterns' key is refused (exit 2), as is an all-'warn' severity map, an unrecognised severity value, and a catch-all ignore. Ignore patterns are matched against the MATCHED SPAN, not the line; keep each one as narrow as the false positive requires ('\b4471\b', never '\d+'), because a broad ignore CAN silence a whole category. Every ignore pattern in effect is printed on every run — that visibility is the only check on how wide you make them.
